Two surveys were conducted in the past years to measure this indicator. The first at the beginning of project implementation and the second in November 2020. Unfortunately the timing of the second survey does not reflect the closing of subprojects such as the infrastructures ones that were supposed to have a direct impact on this indicator. At that time only 3 infrastructural subprojects had concluded but the PIU did not want to postpone it. In addition the survey was conducted during the COVID crisis which affected the results. There were discussions about having a third survey at the end of the project but it never materialized. Finally the suspension of activities of Component 2 had a negative effect on this indicator since that Component was meant to have results on the satisfaction of local residents with tourism development.
